import ast,json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import receipt,file_sha256
root=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-dtype-probe-v1')
runtime=json.loads((root/'runtime.json').read_text());profile=json.loads((root/'dtype_profile.json').read_text())
plan=json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_dtype_probe_plan.json').read_text())
source=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_dtype_probe/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py')
assert file_sha256(source)==plan['source_sha256']
core=next(n.args[0].value for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text())) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='write_text' and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Constant))
assert (root/'dtype_core.py').read_text()==core
assert runtime['status']==profile['status']=='completed'
assert profile['converted_parameter_elements']==profile['changed_compute_modules']==0
assert profile['all_quotes_equal'] and profile['all_quotes_valid']
result={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'retain unsuccessful BF16 performance hypothesis; no policy selection changed'},runtime['model_revision']),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'completed_no_effective_dtype_change','passes':[{k:v for k,v in p.items() if k!='outputs'} for p in profile['passes']],
        'second_repeat_speedup':profile['second_repeat_speedup'],'wall_seconds':runtime['wall_seconds'],
        'diagnosis':'The loaded model has zero BF16 parameters and zero BF16 compute modules. The generic warning did not identify its actual bottleneck. The requested conversion changes no parameter or compute module; a 1.01017 ratio is not a credible speed improvement.',
        'decision':'No precision variant promoted; keep the registered nine-candidate family. Next probe measures compilation overhead and native CUDA/CPU kernels on training states only.',
        'downloaded_files':{str(p):{'sha256':file_sha256(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}}
Path('results/training/qwen38_dtype_probe_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');ledger=json.loads(p.read_text());s=next(s for s in ledger['sessions'] if s['kernel'].endswith('dtype-probe'))
s.update(status='completed_no_effective_dtype_change',hours=runtime['wall_seconds']/3600,script_wall_seconds=runtime['wall_seconds'],script_started_at=runtime['execution_started_at'],script_finished_at=runtime['execution_finished_at'],result_file=str(root/'runtime.json'),hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.')
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
